_doc: Neutral en-us writer placeholders for expEvent_sports_hotel.json. Keys match zh-cn; legacy keys retained.

en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_hotel_ongoing: Back at the hotel suite, the squad has already gathered.
en-us.exp_event_erav_sports_hotel_result: $names$ is laid in the middle of the suite's great bed.
en-us.event_erav_sports_hotel_01:
Drinking, gaming, horsing around - $party.name$ is pulled from lap to lap, belonging to whoever she sits on. To this team she is not a guest; she is the traveling amenity.
When lights-out comes, the main event begins.
en-us.event_erav_sports_hotel_02:
She kneels at the bed's center, serving the players as they close in. The finished sit to the side and watch; the rested queue up behind.
The interpreter-looking one perches at the headboard with his phone, showing a teammate just coming in: "Look. Japanese water girl."
en-us.event_erav_sports_hotel_03:
The size difference is the whole of the night: every inch stretching, bottoming out against her deepest place, her lower belly rounding with each thrust.
She grips the headboard to keep from being pushed away.
en-us.event_erav_sports_hotel_04:
The rotation has no order. Over the whole night, the sheets are changed twice.
"Good girl. ...Next."
en-us.event_erav_sports_hotel_05:
Toward dawn the overlapping snores count the squad for her.
The sheets wad in the corner. Her cheerleading dress is folded neatly by her pillow - it must be worn in the morning. On the schedule, two more away games follow this one.
